**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Gate ToolReturn test on versions that export it**

The matrix in `tests/llmobs/suitespec.yml:484-497` runs this file against older Pydantic-AI releases such as 0.8.1 and 1.0.0, which do not export `pydantic_ai.messages.ToolReturn`; this unguarded import therefore fails before any assertion in those supported lanes even though `_get_tool_output` deliberately catches that compatibility case. Gate the ToolReturn-specific assertions on the version that introduced the type, retain raw-response coverage for older versions, and exercise all selected environment hashes.
